notes:
Passed on the fake backend only by python3 -m mhs.driver check (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored and unreviewed; no hardware was attached and no hardware or sim backend was run. The fake backend is the package's own pure-Python re-implementation of SimpleDroneEnv and Drone (fake.py); gym, numpy and matplotlib were not installed and the upstream clone was never imported, so the fake was not compared with an upstream run and the fidelity gaps say so. The bridge serves the legacy Gym interface (step returns the four-value tuple, reset takes no seed): the seed is recorded by cap.world.seed.v1 and echoed in reset receipts, but the upstream reset restores a fixed state and ignores it, so the trajectory does not depend on the seed. The observation keeps the upstream 3x3 shape, so no array is reduced. Two warning codes are expected for the bridge-derived contract and were not worked around: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (it only records the pending seed) and four G8.NO_UNIT for the inputs the bridge derives (ticks, action.values[*], seed on reset and seed on cap.world.seed.v1); declaring reset/seed actions to add units exposes undescribed scenario/options fields and fails G6/G8. Only catalogue classes are used, so there are no catalogue requests. check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package; gate.digest is the digest the check printed.
